data.narrative:
MaverickX is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Eric Herrera and Jesse Evans that has raised $19M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 9 peer companies (1 public, 8 private), though comparable seed-stage or adjacent-stage peers in this space are sparse, limiting traditional peer-median approaches.

The analysis applies stage-progression valuation, which uses the $19M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in venture capital. This method yields an implied valuation of $48M. The peer-median method is not applicable here; while 9 same-sector peers exist (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen), none satisfy narrow filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier, requiring a minimum of three datapoints to avoid misleading extrapolation.

The single-method triangulation produces a median valuation of $48M, with a low-end estimate of $40M and high-end of $55M. This range reflects the stage-progression methodology anchored to total capital deployed. Key uncertainties include the absence of reliable seed-stage public or private comps in the Climate & Energy vertical, which constrains calibration of the 2.5x step-up multiplier to MaverickX's specific risk profile and market position. Revenue, unit economics, and capital intensity relative to peers would sharpen this estimate materially.
